title: Update installed AgentBoard from published releases

acceptanceCriteria.text: Find and safely install the latest published release without changing existing board data.
Document the update workflow and cover failure and compatibility cases with tests.
Automatically check for releases, notify on stderr, and install only when requested.

notes: The installed CLI checks for published releases, caches results, and reports updates on stderr; installation remains explicit. bun test: 191 pass, 0 fail. Live GitHub release update remains unverified until a release is published.
